title: 📈 XAUUSD Closing Price Analysis & Prediction
description:
Conducted a XAUUSD (Gold) closing price analysis and prediction project using historical market data to improve price prediction beyond the technical analysis tools available in MetaTrader 4 (MT4).

🛠️ **Methodology**

The project utilized RapidMiner and applied two machine learning algorithms:

- 📈 Linear Regression
- 🤖 Support Vector Machine (SVM)

Three training-testing split ratios were evaluated:

- 📊 80:20
- 📊 70:30
- 📊 60:40

Model performance was evaluated using Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) to compare prediction accuracy.

🎯 **Key Results**

- 🥇 **Linear Regression:** Best RMSE of 8.744 using a 70:30 split.
- 📉 **SVM:** Best RMSE of 10.318 using an 80:20 split.
- 🏆 **Best Model:** Linear Regression achieved a lower prediction error than SVM.

💡 **Conclusion**

The results demonstrate that integrating Machine Learning and external data analysis tools can provide a more measurable approach to XAUUSD price prediction and support data-driven trading decisions.

🛠️ **Tools:** RapidMiner, Linear Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), RMSE, MetaTrader 4, Machine Learning
